blocks.en: We next consider the existence of a primitive. Of course, we cannot define a definite integral of a generalized function. Nevertheless, primitives can be shown to exist.
blocks.zh: 接着考虑原函数的存在性. 当然, 不能定义广义函数的定积分. 尽管如此, 仍能证明原函数存在.

blocks.en: Let $I=(a,b)$ be an open interval in $\mathbb{R}$ and $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I)$. Then there exists $u\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I)$ such that $u'=f$. The primitive $u$ is unique up to a constant.
blocks.zh: 设 $I=(a,b)$ 为 $\mathbb{R}$ 中的开区间, 且 $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I)$. 那么存在 $u\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I)$, 使 $u'=f$. 原函数 $u$ 在相差一个常数的意义下唯一.
blocks.label: thm:distribution-primitive-existence

blocks.en: The multidimensional result that any curl-free vectorfield on a simply connected domain is a gradient can also be extended to distributions; the proof is considerably more complicated than in the one-dimensional case and will not be given here.

blocks.en: In particular, if $f$ is a continuous function, then all distributional solutions of \eqref{eq:distribution-linear-first-order-ode} are the classical ones. This is not necessarily true for singular ODEs; for example both the constant 1 and the Heaviside function are solutions of $xy'=0$.
blocks.zh: 特别地, 若 $f$ 为连续函数, 则 \eqref{eq:distribution-linear-first-order-ode} 的所有分布解都是经典解. 对奇异常微分方程, 这不一定成立; 例如常数 1 和 Heaviside 函数都是 $xy'=0$ 的解.
